text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyruvate Kinase Deficiency.

The combination of congenital anemia, apnea, and the specific request to check for jaundice and stool changes strongly points to an enzymatic defect in red blood cell metabolism, particularly given the severity of the anemia in an infant. The pending reticulocyte count and bilirubin levels should confirm hemolysis, while the Hb fraction and LDH will further characterize the disorder. No further diagnostic questions are required at this stage.
